attributes.name: Pharaoh Hound
attributes.description: The Pharaoh Hound is a medium-sized breed of dog that originated in Malta. It is an ancient breed that is believed to be one of the oldest domesticated breeds in the world. The Pharaoh Hound has a medium-sized body, with a muscular and well-defined chest. Its head is broad, with a long muzzle and large, erect ears. Its coat is short and smooth, and comes in shades of tan and red. The Pharaoh Hound is a loyal and affectionate breed, and it enjoys spending time with its family. It is an active breed, and it needs plenty of exercise and mental stimulation.
